title: Fire hits bus at terminal in Roxas, Oriental Mindoro

blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — A passenger bus caught fire at the Roxas Grand Terminal in Barangay Bagumbayan, Roxas town, on Sunday morning. Firefighters quickly extinguished the blaze before it could spread to other vehicles and structures. The incident occurred at 8:14 a.m., according to SFO3 Querube Peradilla, officer-in-charge of the Roxas Bureau of Fire
